description: Native Slovak, crisp Slovak diction. An adult woman in her thirties, a wildly theatrical comic stage diva with a piercing bright soprano. Strong mature vocal projection, metallic whistle-like upper resonance and very precise consonants. Ridiculously elastic melodic rises and drops, smug playful emphasis, clipped decisive punchlines, then a sly drawn-out vowel. An exaggerated and slightly unnerving adult cartoon soprano, never a soft narrator. Her confident adult personality and bold acting dominate every line. Clearly intelligible speech at a moderate pace, not sustained singing. Dry close studio recording without music, echo, ambience or effects.
text: [piercing, theatrical adult soprano] [mischievously] Plán úniku. Z ihriska sa dá uniknúť len tak, že vyrastieš. Ten pohrebák šiel ku kostolu, ak riešiš dospelácke problémy. Podložka a zlatý obal. Ale otec hovorí, že skrat je tiež výhra. Ak si poistený.
